## What happened?

Describe the result and what you expected instead.

## Steps to reproduce

List the steps and specify the planner you used. For cargo bugs, include ship capacity, pre-loaded cargo, overload setting, tiers, ratios, quantities, and any offer limits.

## Environment

Add your browser and device. Attach a screenshot if it helps reproduce the problem.
